thread:
anya: Opening the runtime roadmap Q&A follow-up thread. Post clarifying questions about batching, caching, kernels, or rollout concerns.

sam: Short status: continuous-batching prototype passed internal perf gate; canary window starts tomorrow morning for internal clusters. External opt-in canary the week after.

liam: Measured numbers so far: 12-22% token-cost reduction on conversational traces, 8-18% throughput improvement on GPU hosts. p99 for mixed workloads is targeting <=140ms; microbenchmarks show p50 increases of ~3ms in some configs.

nora: About the KV cache changes 5: we saw memory variance in dev runs. Any hard limits?

sam: Yes 1: there's a per-worker hard cap (`kv_mem_quota`) and an adaptive decay policy. We also emit `kv_cache_reserved_bytes` and `kv_cache_evictions` so ops can monitor. The dev OOM was a missing quota check now patched.

liam: Kernels update: fused-attn upstream licensing cleared; internal branch exists. One Ampere codegen edge case is under investigation. We'll keep fused kernels behind `kernels.fused_attention` flag and gate opt-ins per-cluster.

anya: Ops/Customers ask: how do teams decide to opt in?

sam: We'll expose `batch_fill_pct`, `avg_batch_latency_ms`, `kv_cache_hit_rate`, and `kernel_version` in Console and API. Optimize will simulate historical cost deltas. Recommend customers run the Optimize sim and a short traffic canary with `min_batch_size` tuned for their profile.

nora: If we hit a quality regression during rollout, do we auto-rollback?

liam: Rollout controller supports eval hooks. If an eval metric crosses threshold the controller pauses and notifies the runbook channel; manual rollback is available, and we can configure auto-rollback for critical regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary start queued for cluster 'int-canary-7' 5 ETA 20m.

sam: Action items: I'll add a "latency-first" and "cost-first" example config to the playbook, including recommended `max_batch_latency_ms`, `min_batch_size`, and `kv_mem_quota`.

anya: I'll post the follow-up with links to canary dashboard, the playbook, and a small FAQ. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
